title: Rng-kbqa: Generation-Augmented Iterative Ranking for Knowledge Base Question Answering
summary: This community centers on the 2021 arXiv preprint 'Rng-kbqa: Generation augmented iterative ranking for knowledge base question answering.' The paper is authored by a collaborative team including Xi Ye, Semih Yavuz, Kazuma Hashimoto, Yingbo Zhou, and Caiming Xiong. It is cited within a broader survey of knowledge base question answering techniques, appearing alongside other methods like QA-GNN and DecAF.
